title: IFC-BANK-D: seven-input dissection merges above saturated four-input merges and a capped pool, S_Q = O(2^((223/400) sqrt n)) with S_C = O(n), T = O(n^127 2^((147/100) sqrt n))

40 ceil(log2 n) and Lam = cb - kappa - 4, and ell = Lam recycling levels applying to equal-key groups of w = 2^28 qubits the exact instrument FW of kshitij-hash's F-LIMIT (Kraus operators proportional to the projectors onto the odd-pair cells, the matching cells and {0^w, 1^w}, realized by Hadamard tickets and repeat-until-success uniform registers), each level run on chunks of D_i = 2^cb qubits demanded through per-level buffers with fixed yield and run caps, the last level streamed to the tree by at most Rc_ell = ceil(C_ell/(2^cb - dl)) final requests of 2^cb qubits into a leaf buffer, then a collimation tree with leaf tables from dl = Lam - 1 pooled qubits, one binary linear merge level up to table exponent Lam and, above it, up to JI = ceil(3 Lam/5) levels of four-input merges MERGE4I with streamed, unstored pair fibers of exponent l_j = min(Lam + 1 + 2j, 2 Lam) (saturated, r_j = 0, for j >= ceil((Lam - 1)/2)) and, above them, up to J7 = ceil(173r/2000) levels of fibered seven-input dissection merges MERGE7, level k with fiber width w_k = max(0, 3 Lam - 2 JI - floor(14(k+1)/5)) (each measuring w_k-bit fibers of its triple and four-tuple sums and listing its measured class by a seven-list dissection over 2^(2 Lam - w_k) guesses of a three-list residue, with class lists of at most 2^(Lam+1) + 1 rows), all stored tables of at most 2^Lam rows, then the free-frequency odd-part decoder and the controlled-shift 2-adic part), with every classical record of P except constant-many O(n)-bit staged words held in counted basis-state qubits that carry lazy generation tags of (n+2)^20 bits with exact renumbering, and with P's qubits held in a fixed counted array of quantum slots managed by an indexed free list, outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including wrong extracted labels, FW-stage (repeat-until-success included), supplier and pool aborts, failed and retried merges, four-input and seven-input merges, discarded copies, tag renumbering, initialization and final cleanup, its total charged sequential work is T(N,s) = O(n^127 2^((147/100) sqrt n)) with an absolute constant, including all bank, tag, descriptor and slot operations, every source move, and the one-time preparation and output-first cleanup of the counted physical prefix (proof.md Sections 9-10: T <= c n^120 (T_P + Qcap + HQ + 1) + c n^100 DRAW for n >= n1 (the absolute threshold of proof.md Section 6), where T_P = O(n^(13/2) 2^((147/100) sqrt n)) is P's charged time and Qcap, HQ and DRAW are the source cap, slot count and RAW span defined in proof.md). The coefficient 147/100 is an explicit rational. The uniform bit-length envelope B_T(n) = n^127 2^((147/100) sqrt n) has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

There is exactly one acquisition per request of P, and P makes at most Qcap = 4 n C_0 + K requests, with C_0 and K defined in virtual.md and virtual2.md; the finite branch uses at most N(n+10) copies. For the same IFC-BANK-D algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N >= 2 and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
